run_inference_k400: run inference on Kinetics400 video clips using a loaded model and print top-k predicted action labels
run_inference_imagenet: run inference on ImageNet images using a loaded model and print top-k predicted class labels
run_main_inference: run the main inference entry point with hydra config for k400 or imagenet dataset type
review_video_info: review the _video_info function that extracts frame count and fps from a video file using PyAV
review_runinferenceconfig: review the RunInferenceConfig dataclass that extends FeatureExtractConfig with dataset and inference parameters
